recharge.name: Recharge Movement
recharge.description: Fills the charge pool faster between casts, but holds less of it overall.

capacitor.name: Capacitor Movement
capacitor.description: Holds far more charge, at the cost of filling back up more slowly.

impact.name: Impact Movement
impact.description: Every cast lands harder — no change to the charge pool itself.

spread.name: Spread Movement
spread.description: Casts reach extra targets, each one landing at full strength.
